validation_scope: Local PostgreSQL, pgvector and independent JVMs; native loopback model/MCP/Feishu adapters; M6 date contracts, calendar compatibility, 2524 full chart comparisons, domain facts and focus parity, native Toolkit suspension/resume, scoped artifacts, HMAC, budgets and privacy. M6d packaged process crash recovery, cancellation/privacy competition, deployment image with five native tools and no Python, offline live-validator contracts. Development gate retained: no real model Ziwei selection, real provider/MCP/Feishu tenant or remote CI execution. Compose validation is recorded separately. M5b owner-scoped admission pause/resume, revision and idempotency receipts, PostgreSQL submission/pause races, existing approval/input/cancellation and Feishu continuity, drain counts including uncertain effects, notification and memory backlogs. M5c read-only owner-scoped keyset pages for task, notification, unprojected binding and memory job blockers; terminal-turn residual facts, numeric job ordering, foreign-owner exclusion and content minimization. M5d read-only operations observations, inventory/count comparison, incomplete scan handling and private report files remain covered by separate Python contracts and Compose evidence. M5e offline all-owner privacy snapshot comparison and SQL snapshot queries remain separate from M5f replay. M5f adds independent PostgreSQL forget facts, durable pending barriers, idempotent epoch-scoped replay, bootstrap and isolated JVM recovery. Tests cover lost-source restoration of a real old pg_dump, unknown external commit outcomes, rollback and repeated replay retaining new memory. Independent storage availability, production IAM, latest-authority operations and global cutover are not certified by these local tests.
